title: TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Minimizing the wall-clock time required to reach a target accuracy is crucial in federated learning (FL), where many applications require frequent model updates as data distributions evolve over time. Nevertheless, in heterogeneous environments, slow clients with limited computational and communication capabilities can delay global synchronization, forcing faster clients to wait and increasing the overall training time. To mitigate this straggler effect, recent studies have introduced per-round time constraints and adapted client workloads within the available time. However, these approaches primarily focus on local computation, whereas communication can become a major bottleneck in communication-limited environments, motivating the joint optimization of training workload and communication compression. translated_title: TALLOP：面向时间受限联邦学习的本地训练与通信压缩联合优化
translated_abstract: 在联邦学习（FL）中，最小化达到目标精度所需的实际运行时间至关重要，因为许多应用需要在数据分布随时间演变的情况下频繁更新模型。然而，在异构环境中，计算和通信能力受限的慢速客户端可能会延迟全局同步，迫使较快的客户端等待，从而增加整体训练时间。为了缓解这种掉队者效应，近期研究引入了每轮时间约束，并在可用时间内调整客户端的工作负载。然而，这些方法主要关注本地计算，而在通信受限的环境中，通信可能成为主要瓶颈，这促使人们对训练工作负载与通信压缩进行联合优化。尽管先前的研究已经探索了此类联合优化，但在固定的（原文摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出TALLOP方法，在时间受限的联邦学习中联合优化本地训练工作负载与通信压缩，以缓解异构环境下的掉队者效应并减少达到目标精度所需的实际训练时间。
en_tdlr: TALLOP jointly optimizes local training workloads and communication compression under time-constrained federated learning, mitigating straggler effects in heterogeneous environments to reduce the wall-clock time needed to reach target accuracy.
